description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git rebase functionalities, specifically 'git rebase --onto' and related options. It sets up Git repositories, makes commits, performs rebases with various parameters, and checks that the outcomes match expectations.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates and commits a new change with a specified label.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure of a command.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets a fake editor environment for testing interactive rebases.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that environment variables related to the editor are unchanged after tests.
